name: tripo3d-blender-skill
description: Generate base 3D models with Tripo3D and finish them in Blender

plugins.name: tripo3d-blender
plugins.description: Make 3D models from a written spec to an engine-ready GLB: concept art, scene breakdown into items, matched reference views from every side, reviewed before any credits are spent, one Tripo3D run, and every refinement in Blender, including AAA baking onto a game mesh, levels of detail, GLB export and the hand-off to null3d for web targets.
